scope: Historical audit record for the prior 8-direction runtime temporal capture.
findings: The legacy capture showed the authored 24-frame sequence, but the root advanced on a repeating long-short cadence (approximately 7.6px then 5.07px per frame).
The same-direction F23-to-F00 wrap was not captured in the one-pass-per-direction video.
The visible active-frame burn-in could not be independently verified in the MP4.
A second independently bobbing AuthoredRasterPresentation body was present beside the FastCharacterRuntime body, making the screen read as jitter even when the root ledger was consistent.

disposition.replacement_required: R13 or newer capture must pass local technical gates and independent visual review before disposal is considered.
